mostWorthwhile.text: The sweeper itself was interesting because its wheel drives the brush. Fitting the drive wheel made that connection clear, though choosing the instructed fitting was simple. Was making this one project worth the time spent? Mixed: the gear connection at step 2 was useful, but much of the assembly felt routine.

leastWorthwhile.text: I fitted the second wheel because the instructions required it; it felt fine but added little beyond completing the pair. Hypothetically, I would shorten the assembly. That would lose some sense of putting every part in place.

surprise.text: The drive wheel turning the smaller gear in the opposite direction clarified how the brush is powered.

arbitrary.text: I followed each fitting goal because it was required, but none felt purposeless. The second wheel was the most routine, though fitting it felt fine rather than wasteful.

continue.text: I would stop here; I understand the sweeper well enough and don't feel a particular urge to make another project.
